rule:
Function-body tasks from the set C v2 pinned snapshots. File: tracked .ts/.mts/.js/.mjs, not .d.ts, not under test/tests/__tests__/spec/fixture(s)/example(s)/doc(s), not *.test/*.spec, content sha256 in the repo's held-out contentSha256 list, parses cleanly. Function: a named function or method declaration whose body block has 2-15 inner lines, at most 600 characters, at least one statement. Order eligible functions per repo by id = sha256('peaceai-ext-c-tasks:v1
'+repo+'
'+path+'
'+name+'
'+bodyLine) ascending; take the first 20.
task: The model gets the file with the body block [bodyStart, bodyEnd) replaced by '{}' and must produce the body. Graded statically, never by running the target repo's code: pass = the produced file parses and its body is token-equal to the original (TypeScript scanner tokens, trivia ignored); fail = parses but differs, or no output; ungradable = the produced file does not parse at the original span boundary (reported, never dropped from the denominator).
